cd /workspace/mytests && timeout 300 python3 - <<'EOF'
from harness import *
MAX=(1<<63)-1
# single data frame with a MAX-length payload -> receipt exceeds MAX
d = doc(definitions=[['big','b"x" * %d' % MAX]], timeout_ms=5,
        cases=[case('a',[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ big }}","End_Stream":True}])])
print('one MAX frame:', run(d, debug=True)[0])
# payload MAX-22 -> action exactly MAX? time8+stream4+kind1+len8+payload+end1 = 22 overhead
d = doc(definitions=[['big','b"x" * %d' % (MAX-22)]], timeout_ms=5,
        cases=[case('a',[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ big }}","End_Stream":True}])],
        events=[{"at":1,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"","end":True}])
o = run(d, debug=True)[0]
print('exact MAX receipt:', {k:o['cases'][0][k] for k in ('state','sent','payload_bytes','frames')})
# two frames of 2^62 -> receipt overflow
d = doc(definitions=[['big','b"x" * %d' % (2**62)]], timeout_ms=5,
        cases=[case('a',[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ big }}","End_Stream":False},
                         {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ big }}","End_Stream":True}])])
print('two big frames:', run(d, debug=True)[0])
# channel with two parts of 2^62 -> channel length overflow
d = doc(definitions=[['big','b"x" * %d' % (2**62)]], timeout_ms=5,
        channels=[ch('c',(None,'{{ big }}'),(None,'{{ big }}'))])
print('channel overflow:', run(d, debug=True)[0])
# definition length overflow
d = doc(definitions=[['big','b"x" * %d' % (MAX)], ['bigger','big + big']], timeout_ms=5)
print('definition overflow:', run(d, debug=True)[0])
# slice of huge
d = doc(definitions=[['big','b"x" * %d' % (MAX)]], timeout_ms=5,
        channels=[ch('c',(None,'{{ big[0:10] }}'))])
o = run(d, debug=True)[0]
print('slice of huge:', o['channels'][0]['bytes'], o['channels'][0]['error'])
# received receipt overflow
d = doc(definitions=[['big','b"x" * %d' % (MAX-22)]], timeout_ms=5,
        cases=[case('a',[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[["a","b"]]}])],
        events=[{"at":1,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"{{ big }}","end":True},
                {"at":2,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"{{ big }}","end":True}])
print('received overflow:', run(d, debug=True)[0])
